preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The length of the word must be between 1 and 999 characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a single character if the word length is odd, or two characters if the word length is even.

postconditions.expression: return_value == word[len(word) // 2] if len(word) % 2 == 1 else return_value == word[len(word) // 2 - 1:len(word) // 2 + 1]
postconditions.description: The output must be the middle character if the word length is odd, or the two middle characters if the word length is even.
